metadata.title: Totally Geodesic Submanifolds of Teichmüller Space in Complex Dimension at Least Three
metadata.abstract: Let $N\subset \mathcal{T}_{g,n}$ be a connected complex totally geodesic submanifold. We prove that if $\dim_{\mathbb{C}}N\ge3$, then $N$ is the image of an entire Teichmüller space under a covering construction induced by a finite branched cover of marked surfaces. This answers a question of Arana-Herrera and Wright.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 研究复维数至少三的连通复全测地 Teichmüller 子流形，证明其来自有限分支覆盖所给的整个 Teichmüller 空间像。
analysis.breakthrough: 在指定维数范围内回答 Arana-Herrera–Wright 提出的问题。
analysis.limitations: 复维数下界不可省略；并非任意 Teichmüller 子集或低维全测地曲线的分类。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。未见 AI 协作声明仅指这些已检查来源，不代表已核验整篇论文完全由人类完成。
analysis.priorityReason: 特殊度量下的子空间刚性结果较强，和几何拓扑交叉紧密。
